blocks.text: “The next few Scrolls are a special series concerning delicate subjects bringing forth divine truths and reveals much of these evils will occur again in the future of this age! It’s done by the sensitive Holy Spirit!”

HOSEA ORDERED TO MARRY A PROSTITUTE— “Right away we see something alarming; Israel has horribly backslidden and would no longer listen to God’s Word, so the Lord took extreme measures to reveal their sunken depravity! He commands the prophet to bring it out in the open by using shocking measures!”” Hosea 1:2, “Go take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms!” It is the same in the Hebrew translation, a literal whore.) — “This was done as a sign to Israel revealing what they were doing, and what would be done in the future!” “Verses 4-9, show each child born revealed what God would do unto Israel!” Verses 8-9, “Reveal a later son was born and God called his name Lo-am-mi: for ye are not my people and I will not be your God! But in verse 10 we see the Lord’s great love and compassion for Israel! When He declares, in the place where it was said unto them, ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, ye are the sons of the Living God!” — “The next verse shows that they will be gathered again at the end! — Hosea 2:5-7, “shows Israel’s lovers are represented as giving to her six things — bread, water, wool, flax, oil, and drink!’ — ‘While the Lord speaks of His own precious gifts of love to His people by contrast as being “seven” in number!”’ Verse 8, corn, wine, oil, silver, gold, and verse 9, wool and flax! But they took the multiplied gold and prepared it for Baal. — Idolatry!” (Vr. 8) Most of the country of Israel will at the end again go into idolatry, (except the 144,000 Israelites) “and the other false Jews will make a covenant with the beast! Isa. 28:18 Dan. 9:27 — And joined to Rev. 17:4-5” — “Like Judah did, the Jews at the end will be joined to a harlot and will hardly even know it until too late! (Gen. 38:15-24-26) Also read Mal. 2:11, strange god!’’ — ‘“‘Then in Hosea 3:1, reveals that the woman left and the Lord commanded him to go get her again, symbolizing how Israel would leave the Lord back and forth again.” Verse 2, “shows he paid a price for her. Hosea 4:16-17, “For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer and Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone. Even after all of this God shows His great mercy for His children!” — Hosea 14:4-5, “I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely — for mine anger is turned away from him! Verse 9 reveals wisdom!”

EZEK. CHAP. 16, “REVEALS the horrible wretched condition of Israel, she is threatened with severe judgments, but mercy is promised for her in the end!’ — “This chapter also reveals literally physical and religious fornication. When people turn to idols a hysterical kind of madness follows producing the worst kind of sins!” Verses 5-9, “reveal God’s sympathy, care and delicate mercy to His chosen”! — Verse 10, “reveals He covered her with fine linen and silk. In the next verses 11-14 shows the bestowed gifts which represent and are symbols also of the divine gifts coming to His true church!” “I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck. And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head! Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom!” “This reveals how good the Lord was, but now let’s take a look at what Israel did to Him.” — “She trusted in her own beauty and played the harlot and pouredst out thy fornications on everyone that passed by, his it was!” — (Verse 15) — “The crimes against the flesh and God were so horrible we bring it here directly from the ‘original Hebrew translation’, same as King James but it explains the depth of the sins”. (Read, your Bible and ee) Verses 16-19, “And you took your robes and made yourself luxurious beds and fornicated upon them, — without payment or fee! You also took your beautiful jewels, — My gold, and My silver, — which I had given to you, and made yourself forms like males, and fornicated with them! And took your bordered robes and covered them, and put My oil, and My incense before them! And My bread of fine flour, oil, and honey which I had given you to eat, ‘you placed “before them” for a dainty’, says the Mighty Lord!” — All this fits right in at the end, they will do the same thing with what God gives them putting it in the beast kingdom, and use for idols!” Dan. 11:38-39 — Rev. 18:12 — Isa. 2:20-21)—“Now continuing in ‘Hebrew’ Ezk. 16:20 “And you took your sons and your daughters, whom you had borne to Me, and have sacrificed them to be devoured! Verse 21, Were your whoredoms nothing? but that you must murder My children, and give them to be passed round as food?” Deut. 28:57, “Foretold similarity! (Bible translators confirm by footnote: Verses 20-21, “This striking phrase clearly indicates that cannibalism, even on their own children by their parents, was one of the horrors of the pagan worship of the apostate Hebrews! We need not therefore wonder at the unmeasured divine denunciation against paganism!”) “This occurs even today in remote places! — “The worship of idols produces sexual perversion and the lowest depravity! The sins of the nations and the U.S.A. are now preparing to be mixed with idols!” (Rev. 9:20-21 — Rev. 18:14-18) “Now continuing Ezk. 16, verses 25, 26 “And at the top of every street you have constructed couches, and prostituted your beauty, and spread your legs for every one that passed by, and increased your whoredoms! You have also fornicated with the big-bodied sons of the Egyptians, your neighbours.”” — Verse 28, “You also whored with the Assyrians, but you were not satiated!” (Verse 29, Then you extended your fornication unto the Chaldeans but even then you were unsatiable and couldest not be satisfied, Verse 30, Why! your heart should have been sick, says the Mighty Lord!” Verse 33, “They give pay to every prostitute, but you gave pay to your lovers! and bribed them to come to you from round about to whore you!”’ Verse 34 “And you are different to other women with your whoremongers, — they do not follow you to fornicate, — but you give to them pay, and they give not pay to you — so you are different!’’ — Verse 38 — “reveals God’s divine wrath on them. Verses 42, 60-63, “reveal God’s forgiveness and mercy!”

EZEK. CHAP. 7 SHOWS ISRAEL’S HORRIBLE IDOLA- TRY AND FINAL DESOLATIONS— Verses 5-6, “Thus saith the Lord God an only evil has come, the end is come, the end is come it watcheth for thee! Behold it is come!” — Verse 20, ‘“‘As for the beauty of his ornament he sitteth it in majesty but they made the images of their abominations”! “All this is prophetic and ties in with the end of the age! Dan. 11:31 (latter part, “And shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate! (The Hebrew translation) “says establish the Desolating Brute!’ — Also Mark 13:14, (in the Greek) says, “The ‘brutal desolator’ standing where it ought not!” This plainly reveals an idol in association to the beast!” — “So we see a form of madness appearing soon, but not even their silver and gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord!” (Ezek. 7:19) Scroll #72
